comment: Talk about a pivotal week. The difference in FedExCup bonus points here as compared to what’s ahead in the Playoffs aside, it doesn’t get more extreme than having the chance to ride Scheffler to force the action. I broke it all down in my  Fantasy Insider .

expert_title: Senior Manager, TOUR & Golfbet Editorial & Distribution
comment: I am pretty certain I have mis-managed my approach to Scheffler starts in Segment 3, but I will take my chances backing the best player in the world for double points.
His record after the first three majors of the season is P2-third-P2. If I am going to burn him, and baby I am, let's do it in a shootout to catch up.
If you’re looking to save a couple starts for Scheffler in the playoffs, pick players you think can get hot and rack up birdies.
Fresh off contending at The Open, let’s roll with Suber, who still needs to make up ground for the FedExCup Playoffs. In great form and plenty motivated.
